title: Alley East of Coil Avenue / West of Alameda Street / Colon Street / Pacific Coast Highway / Temporary Closure
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Engineer be instructed to report with recommendations to temporarily close the alley east of Coil Avenue and west of Alameda Street between Colon Street and the Pacific Coast Highway, pursuant to California Vehicle Code Section 21101.4. PRESENTED BY: TIM McOSKER Councilmember, 15th District E. SECONDED BYAcel&e 4lee./ OCT 1 6 2026
